fns.desc: hostapd_parse_he_srg_bitmap(): guard allows bitpos==64 (`bitpos<0||bitpos>64` only rejects >64), but bitmap[] is declared u8[8] (ap_config.h:1032-1033) so valid indices are 0-7; bitpos=64 causes `bitmap[64/8]=bitmap[8]` — a genuine 1-byte out-of-bounds write. Off-by-one should be `bitpos > 63`. Reachable via he_spr_srg_bss_colors/he_spr_srg_partial_bssid config directives.
